description: Keep the suggested saved replies (the first time), and add replies the team has sent at least twice since, with the words their comments share as keywords. Nothing is removed or rewritten. After keeping, rewrite the starters (source starter) in the brand's voice from workspace_get with saved_reply_save, and give each the words that should suggest it.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: saved_replies_refresh
title: Keep and refresh saved replies
